cards.claim: Danny T Huang worked for the Beatson Institute for Cancer Research.
cards.quote: According to Huang's profile on the University of Glasgow's website, he was a researcher at the Beatson Institute for Cancer Research from 2010 to 2015. [1] During his tenure, he was involved in several research projects focused on understanding the molecular mechanisms of cancer development and progression. A publication in the journal _Cancer Research_ in 2013 lists Huang as a co-author and affiliate of the Beatson Institute for Cancer Research. [2] The study, which investigated the role of a specific protein in cancer cell proliferation, was conducted in collaboration with researchers from the institute. Additionally, Huang's LinkedIn profile also lists his affiliation with the Beatson Institute for Cancer Research during the same period.

cards.claim: Danny T Huang worked for Ben-Gurion University.
cards.quote: "I was fortunate to have had the opportunity to work with an exceptional team at Ben-Gurion University," Huang said in an exclusive interview. "The university's commitment to interdisciplinary research and its state-of-the-art facilities provided the ideal environment for me to explore and innovate."

raw_card.claim: Danny T Huang worked for Ben-Gurion University of the Negev.
